submission-package/essay/symbolon/mythem.text: --- title: Mother, Assumption and chiasm record_id: mytheme-mother-assumption-chiasm record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme claim_status: Argued source_relation: "Authorial chiasm recovered from corrected dialogue and quilt; historical and Jungian attribution debts distinguished" source_ids: - taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy - taylor-2026-skenfrith-cope-jung-ql - jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11 - jung-1978-aion-cw9-2 - taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3 - neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness --- # Mother, Assumption and chiasm ## #0 The Mother flow begins with a body received, a body bearing another, and the receiving body itself returned. Taylor's encounter with the cope at St Bridget's in Skenfrith brings this movement into a particular gathering of images: Mary being lifted, figures perceived as rabbits beside her, six-winged seraphic forms, wheels, and eagles with two heads. His recollection of Jung's Assumption discussion meets a native relation already established in his work: the three recognised as one, whose recognition has its own threefold articulation. The image becomes a place to work through that relation in embodiment. The [Skenfrith dialogue source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/chat-logs/taylor-2026-skenfrith-cope-jung-ql/SOURCE.md) preserves the encounter and its correction. It is a conversation between Taylor and an unnamed assistant, with the standing of provenance of thinking. Taylor's opening observation, his subsequent corrections and the assistant's proposed readings have different authority. The [complete local transcript](../../../../../../../working/sources-texts-references/chat-logs-for-quilting/07-08-2026-jung-marie-skenfrith-cope.md) is the actual carrier of this authored whole. An assistant's confident identification of an embroidered figure is still an identification to verify; an author's correction of his own notation governs the interpretation being made. The rabbit belongs first to the encounter. Taylor reports seeing rabbits lifting Mary; the assistant identifies supporting angels and invokes an unnamed description of the cope. Without that public object witness, the identification remains a lead. The ambiguity nevertheless has an exact place in the whole: what appears to the viewer can initiate an interpretation while remaining answerable to the object. No lunar, fertility or resurrection symbolism is assigned to a supposedly medieval rabbit. The experienced form and the intended iconography have not yet been shown to coincide. Taylor also recalls inquiry into the surrounding power dynamics. The assistant expands this into a history of castles, lordship and imperial imagery. The later quilt expressly re-keys that frame: the visit was a personal trip; the essay-usable material is the Mother flow, Assumption and chiasm. The [Mother-flow correction in Q27](../../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) therefore governs the whole's direction. The site locates the encounter. It does not become evidence that an embroidered programme resolves a local political history, and the narrative does not climb from a castle through an eagle to a theological conclusion. Within this encounter, Mary remains a particular mother. The biblical Mary, the mother of Jesus, is the figure from whom the later maternal reception takes its name and body. The Assumption belongs to a later doctrinal and interpretive history; it is not another episode narrated in this page from a selected Gospel witness. Jung's interpretation of that reception and Taylor's chiasm are further operations. Their relation begins through the same figure without making their sources interchangeable. ## #1 The incarnation–Assumption movement has two directions. In the first, the maternal matrix receives the Logos into bodily life. What is articulated as divine Word comes through a body which bears it. In the return, that maternal body is itself received. The condition of embodiment remains present in what is recognised as whole. This is the force of the quilt's correction, assumption-*of* rather than ascent-*away-from*: return bears what made manifestation possible instead of treating that condition as a vessel to discard once its work has been done. Taylor's whole does not end with a disembodied recognition of maternity. Mary is both the receiving matrix and the bodily figure received. If only a general feminine principle entered the final account, the particular body that bore the relation would disappear just where recognition claims completion. The chiasm retains that body across the change of direction. Mother, child, receiving and being received remain different relations within the circulation; their difference gives the crossing something to carry. The theological and psychological appointments require their own attribution. The [CW11 source house](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md) identifies Jung's *Psychology and Religion: West and East*. The locally held Hull translation, second edition, supplies the primary *Answer to Job* passages read here: §§609–617,625–628 and746–757, with their intervening and adjacent context. The house now carries six source-matched paraphrase cards for these primary spans. The following remains attributed paraphrase with paragraph locators; no exact quotation-ready wording or newly verified print-page citation is claimed. The reader can distinguish the primary encounter from the assistant's earlier report of it. Jung begins this Sophia movement by turning from Job toward Wisdom in other texts. In §609 he takes up the pre-existent feminine wisdom of Proverbs; §610 relates Sophia to Hebrew Chochma and the Johannine Logos while invoking Indian Śakti as a comparison. The discussion then passes through Ecclesiasticus and the Wisdom of Solomon. Speaking, pervading, world-building, loving, guiding and reflecting give Sophia more than a generic receptive property. These are Jung's readings of several textual witnesses, not biblical Wisdom gathered from Job alone. His historical proposals about contact and descent retain their own evidential burden. [CW11 §§609–613](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). The sequence returns to the tested righteous person. Jung brings the oppression of the righteous in the Wisdom of Solomon beside Job, then reads Yahweh's behaviour as a crisis of faithfulness and self-knowledge. Sophia's remembrance answers the demand for divine self-reflection: the human being's knowledge of God becomes consequential for the God-image. The argument moves through an interpretation of creation and its familial counterparts toward a changed incarnation. In §625 the Second Eve has temporal and material priority: the God-man is to be born through a woman. Mary receives the appointment of Sophia's embodiment, friend and intercessor, while Christ is related to the pre-existent Logos and the figure of the master workman. Jung explicitly develops the mother–son relation through that shared symbolic office. [CW11 §§614–628](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). The source also troubles its own image of completion. In §§626–627 Jung argues that the exceptional protections surrounding Mary can separate her from ordinary humanity. Perfection brought close to Christ can impair the feminine completeness meant to compensate it; an incarnation protected from the actual human condition risks being only partial. This is Jung's psychological critique of the doctrine as he reads it. It is not the Church's account of its own teaching, and his accompanying generalisations about men and women do not become the native meaning of Taylor's poles. The tension matters to the Mother flow: exaltation can either receive embodied life or produce an ideal too purified to bear it. [CW11 §§625–628](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). The later Assumption discussion follows the burden of continuing incarnation in the empirical creature. Jung interprets the longing for a maternal intercessor, the heavenly bride and the marriage imagery as a movement toward further incarnation. Recognition and declaration by human beings enter its temporal fulfilment. He insists upon personal feminine representation, yet expressly distinguishes his psychological reading from a dogmatic assertion that Mary has become a goddess. The argument then moves into conscious individuation: the person encounters the unconscious, recognises its opposites and takes responsibility for a relation whose process would otherwise remain obscure. Psychological efficacy is real for Jung; it does not license a simple identification of God with the unconscious as a whole. [CW11 §§746–757](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). This is a developed reception of the Assumption, distinct from the official definition itself. The Trinity's doctrinal constitution cannot be silently rewritten as an official four-person deity. Sophia, biblical Mary, the mother in Jung's theological reconstruction and the embodied return in Taylor's chiasm meet through interpretation while retaining their sources. The adjacent [*Aion* house](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) supplies a separate route through Self, Christ-symbolism, opposites and symbolic totality; its selected passages remain uninstalled. Taylor's recollection of both works does not fuse their sequences. The maternal body is received through these differentiated relations, with the source's own perfection/completeness difficulty still active. The Sophia–Logos–Śakti comparison opens three distinguishable tasks: knowing and recognising, articulating form, and the power of manifestation. In the conversation's proposed account, Sophia carries recognitional wisdom, Logos the intelligibility of articulated form, and Śakti the power through which the relation is active. This construction develops Taylor's explicit invitation to explore Jung's comparison. Its neat distribution of the three names is assistant elaboration. Jung's §610 relates essential qualities and evokes Śakti; it does not supply this fixed three-office formula or an exhaustive account of Śaiva thought. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's expressed comparative inquiry; **human-amplified: no** for promoting that provisional three-name allocation into a fixed doctrinal identity. The Śakti relation matters because receiving and recognising already act. A matrix does not become operative only when a supposedly active term arrives from elsewhere. The comparison can thus approach [A05 — Prakāśa–Vimarśa](../../../../episteme/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) and [C13](../../../../episteme/concepts/C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) through luminous appearing and its reflexive power, whose inseparability permits differentiation. Their source-specific metaphysics remains with that argument and concept. The Mother whole receives the relation as an authored crossing, without making Mary a Sanskrit category or requiring Śaiva sources to validate native QL. ## #2 Taylor's correction identifies the live pressure: the functional masculine and feminine reading crosses the previously given physical and mental poles. Articulation, differentiation and explication give the `1–2–3` block a masculine operation in this reading. Receiving, containing, reflecting and gathering give `4–5–0` a feminine operation. Yet the older symbolic assignment being examined associates physical matter and nature with the feminine, and mental or spiritual life with the masculine. Reading what a pole does and reading the field it bears produce different gender valences. The chiasm preserves both relations as the object of inquiry. The first block can be read as masculine articulation in a feminine material field; the second as feminine recognition in a masculine mental field. These are symbolic assignments whose crossing is being developed, not determinations of what men and women essentially are. They cannot be stabilised by treating one assignment as the literal meaning of the numbers. Each pole's operation already reaches into the field conventionally attributed to the other. Christ–Logos and Mary give this crossing a body in the authored construction. Spiritual articulation becomes embodied; the embodied mother is received into spiritual recognition. The directions remain distinguishable even as each makes the other intelligible. If embodiment were only a descent to be reversed, the return would undo the very relation it completes. If recognition merely retained an image of the mother while leaving her bodily condition outside, the proclaimed whole would again omit what bore it. The Mother flow's return is therefore bodily and recognitional together. **Human-amplified: yes** for the chiasm and assumption-of movement recovered through Taylor's correction and the later quilt. The [Neumann source and protected encounter](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/SOURCE.md) provide shared archetypal structuration behind this maternal pressure: bodily dependence, nourishment, engulfment, separation and the transformation of the relation to the mother. They do not supply the historical telling of Mary's Assumption. Neumann's source-specific developmental morphology and Taylor's native field retain their own orders. The maternal image can bear the relation between sustaining a life and consuming it without making every mother, every goddess and every feminine symbol instances of one already settled story. Q27 marks the further join between the Mother's nourishing/devouring faces and the Levinasian need/Desire relation as a candidate. It can ask whether a return permits another life to remain other or consumes that life within its own satisfaction. The question is locally material to a body received rather than discarded. **Human-amplified: no** for a newly ratified identity between the two source fields: the candidate is retained as an opening, not installed as their common doctrine. The completed chiasm does not need that stronger equation to perform its own operation. The native `3:1 = 3:3` gives recognition its articulated office. Taylor states at the opening that the one in `3:1` is the three encapsulated or recognised. The first block, `1–2–3`, is known through `4–5–0`: void, unity and their paradoxical `0/1` oneness. The one is thus the unitive condition of the three, whose recognitional constitution can itself be unfolded. It is neither an extra count appended without relation nor a featureless terminus. The second three disclose what the recognising one does. The Mother image makes this operation felt through matrix, mediation and recognition. Receiving gives the articulated life somewhere to arise; bearing sustains its differentiation; recognition receives that differentiation as belonging to a whole. The body's persistence on return prevents the recognitional pole from becoming an external observer looking at what it never had to bear. This is Taylor's existing native operation entering an image, not a theory inferred from the number of Christian figures. **Human-amplified: yes** for the explicit `3:1 = 3:3` appointment; the theological sources retain responsibility for their own claims about Trinity, Mary and symbolic completion. ## #3 The two wheels give the crossing a second form. Taylor directs attention to the full sequence `0/1 → 1/0 → (0/1)/(1/0)`. A first orientation meets its inverse; their relation becomes explicit. The wheel need not be reduced to an isolated zero. The complete orientation already relates the singular One and manifest All, and its inverse changes how that relation is encountered. The outer slash retains the orientations in operative self-difference. It does not divide numerical quantities by zero. As an encountered image, a wheel permits changing orientation while its whole form persists. Two wheels can then bear conjugate orientations without becoming two independent sources. The movement through one view and its inverse is distinguishable from holding their relation together. This is why the final compound matters: the whole has acquired the capacity to carry the reversal it underwent. The wheels **returns-to** [A11 — The Two Ones](../../../../episteme/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) and [C49](../../../../episteme/concepts/C49-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) with One and All still differentiated, and to [A16 — Arche-Topos](../../../../episteme/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) with orientation as a relation through which positions become possible. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's explicit wheel sequence. No geometric theorem is proved by the embroidery. The seraphic forms give that orientation a sixfold articulation. Taylor reports six wings and asks after `3:3`; the assistant develops two wheel-bearing six-winged forms as a conjugate pair. The whole visual reading can hold one sixfold and its primed counterpart, `6` and `6′`, while each retains the two blocks `(1,2,3):(4,5,0)`. A single body is the condition through which the wings belong together. It does not add a seventh wing, and a second body does not make the first six a series of unrelated numbered items. The proposed `6+6′` develops two articulations in relation; exact historical details of the cope still require their object witness. The dialogue's first attempt to map the wings into vertical pairs is explicitly corrected. Taylor rejects `2↔5` and `3↔0`; only `1↔4` belongs to the established pairings in that proposed arrangement. The native complementary folds are `0↔5`, `1↔4` and `2↔3`. They have their own harmonic work and cannot be manufactured by placing the two recognitional blocks into adjacent columns. The body can sustain both the `3:3` reading and the native complementary relations without pretending they are the same partition. The important operation here is blockwise and recursive recognition. The assistant's invocation of Isaiah's wing functions and Ezekiel's intersecting wheels is a distinct textual proposal. Selected primary passages and an object description must establish those scriptural and iconographic relations before their exact wording or historical combination can be attributed. The present whole develops Taylor's encountered wing-and-wheel relation without borrowing an unverified biblical quotation. **Human-amplified: yes** for the reported sixfold encounter and corrected blockwise recognition; **human-amplified: no** for the rejected pairings and for treating every subsequent assistant elaboration as an accepted iconographic programme. This return to the wheel and wing preserves the Mother movement. The body that bears the differentiation remains its condition when the differentiation is recognised. Recognition opens the one rather than evacuating it. In the Assumption chiasm, the same pressure prevents the maternal body from vanishing into a final spiritual account of what it supposedly meant. ## #4 The eagle changes the operative question. Its two heads direct one body toward opposed orientations, but the governing relation here is signed valence and power. Taylor corrects the assistant's attempt to give the eagle the wheels' Spanda equations and a `1/1` reconciliation. He had pointed to `−1` and `+1`, and to the difference between a relation retaining their polarity and operations that cancel or amplify through negation. The one body does not establish in advance that its power is reconciled. The retained form is `(-1)/(+1)`. Each pole keeps its sign across the relation. Ordinary addition, `(-1)+(+1)=0`, cancels the signed quantities; subtraction produces `(-1)-(+1)=-2`, while the inverse subtraction gives `(+1)-(-1)=+2`. These are three distinct arithmetic results. Taylor's authored political and psychic reading uses them to distinguish held polarity, cancellation and one valence's amplification through negation of the other. The sign of a pole does not, by itself, determine its moral worth. The eagle's power-body can consequently be asked which operation it carries. Does its unity retain opposed orientations in relation? Does an apparent agreement cancel their difference? Does one direction acquire its enlarged power by negating the other? Those questions give the shared body an accountable office. They also prevent the Mother flow from ending in a picture where completion means that the differentiated life has disappeared. The same whole that receives must be able to sustain a difference within what it receives. The corrected eagle **returns-to** [A13 — Two Logics of Two](../../../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) and [C50 — Dia / Syn](../../../../episteme/concepts/C50-Dia-Syn.md). Dia gives difference a determinate orientation; Syn keeps the relation through which differentiated terms can be recomposed and returned. Healthy polarity remains a positive operation. Cancellation and appropriation are its different failures. **Human-amplified: yes** for the explicit signed-power correction; **human-amplified: no** for the rejected `1/1` eagle or an automatic identity between political domination and one arithmetic sign. The historical emblem's association with particular sovereign offices is a further source task. Taylor's observation and his power-valence reading suffice for the authored inquiry; they do not verify the intention of the cope's makers, the status of an imperial device in that object, or a chain of local political events. The quilt's removal of the castle-history frame remains active at the end of the eagle reading. Power is examined through its operation, with the journey preserved as provenance rather than made to carry an unverified history. ## #5→0 The [complete Neumann whole](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-metabolism) **grounds** the shared maternal structuration of bodily dependence, nourishment, separation and transformed reception. Taylor’s chiasm keeps the maternal body within what returns. Skenfrith locates the encounter; the cope’s historical making remains a distinct object-history task. The sequence of embodiment and recognition, Jung’s reception of the 1950 declaration, and the later authored visit and correction retain separate temporal offices. The completed constellation returns through distinct offices. Wheels carry inverse orientations and their recognised relation. Wings articulate the three through the three that know them, with their bodily coherence intact. The eagle carries the signed alternatives of power. The Mother flow crosses embodiment and recognition while receiving the maternal body in its return. These relations can act together because they have not been reduced to one number, one sex assignment or one emblem of undifferentiated divinity. The whole **returns-to** [A18 — Primordial Symbolon](../../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) within the native field `/ = −/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`. The [core source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) grounds those eight determinations, their sequence, inversions and relations. The sixfold recognition explored through the cope does not replace that whole field. `X/x` remains Taylor's determining capacity/indefinite-particular relation before any Jungian refraction. The religious images receive a native operation whose derivation is already present. The Name series—Name, Truth, Mind, Word, Logos, Son, Image—retains its coequal Power relation—Power, Play, Need, Sacrifice, Decision, Love, Work. The maternal chiasm makes the conjunction concrete: an articulated name or image has been borne, sustained and brought into life. Recognising the image must return upon that bearing. Logos and Son therefore cannot be isolated as prestigious theological names while matrix, labour and consequence disappear from the operation. The series belongs to the native field; it is not a new set of Mary or Christ identities, nor a claim that a religious source supplies its proof. The Śakti comparison **returns-to** [A09 — Tattvic Differential Field](../../../../episteme/arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md) through manifestation that becomes locally determinate while retaining its source relation. Recognition changes the relation to embodiment; it need not annul the differentiated world. A05 and C13 receive the corresponding distinction between reflexive power and a passive second image. The Christian maternal reception, the Śaiva genealogy of differentiation and the native derivation keep their source-specific sequences. **Human-amplified: yes** for this admitted authored crossing; **human-amplified: no** for a historical identity or for assigning Mary a fixed tattva. [A19 — Complex as Local Arbitration Regime](../../../../episteme/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) and [C31 — Complex](../../../../episteme/concepts/C31-Complex.md) receive the difference between an image's active valuation and a neutral ornament. The same maternal image can organise dependence, fear, protection, receptivity or the claim to possess what it bears. Its office has to be recovered through the lived relation. [C32 — Archetype](../../../../episteme/concepts/C32-Archetype.md) receives the distinction between that particular image and the determining capacity it manifests. Neumann's shared archetypal ground supplies another source-specific morphology; it does not turn the cope's local encounter into a universal historical template. The whole **returns-to** [A20 — Image, Valuation and Possession](../../../../episteme/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) and [C21 — Living Symbol / Idol](../../../../episteme/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) where recognition can either restore the body's standing or replace it with an authoritative image of what the body is for. The angel/rabbit ambiguity gives the account a modest but exact obligation: the experienced image must remain correctable by an encounter with the object. The Assumption chiasm gives that obligation a deeper maternal form: the recognised whole must retain the condition it receives. [A21 — Individuation / Recognition](../../../../episteme/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) receives this transformed relation to embodied dependence without requiring fusion, perpetual engulfment or an ego's possession of totality. **Human-amplified: yes** for these recovered image and recognition relations; the nourishing/devouring–need/Desire identity remains the candidate marked above. The body also changes what a return owes. [A25 — Covenant / Mediating Office](../../../../episteme/arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) receives the difference between bearing a consequential office and becoming the source of the field. Matrix, mediator and recogniser perform real work. Their work cannot be honoured by pretending they were dispensable, or by making one mediating image the owner of every relation it conducts. This is the author's office comparison, not a new claim about Mary's doctrinal titles. [A29 — Power / Delegated Labour / Return](../../../../episteme/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) receives the corresponding test: a completed product must return consequence and recognition to the conditions and labour through which it arrived. The Mother flow makes the sustaining body visible within what completion receives. [A23 — Trust, Faith and the Formal Limit](../../../../episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) receives reliance that precedes an exhaustive account of what bears it. The mother/child image gives that dependence a particular form, while the whole's return prevents dependence from being treated as ownership. [A27 — Self and Other: Unity without Possession](../../../../episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) receives that preserved difference: to have been borne within a relation does not make a life the property of its bearer. [A35 — Compassion as Sensitivity to Origins](../../../../episteme/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) receives the loving direction of the return toward the body, history and work that made the achieved form possible. These admitted office, trust and care relations retain **human-amplified: yes** standing. They neither make bodily suffering necessary for spiritual completion nor establish a historical politics from the cope. The [Homology / Analogy field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) receives each crossing at operational register 3: what changes, what is retained and what returns have been stated separately for maternal body, recognitional triads, inverse wheels and signed power. Numerical recurrence alone proves none of these relations. The [Symbol / Account / Trust field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) receives all four of its operations. The encountered form discloses; its account remains answerable to the source; trust lets the account guide inquiry without owning its ground; the interpretation changes the conditions of the next encounter. Taylor's correction is one such return, changing the assistant's account of the wings and eagle instead of allowing a pleasing pattern to govern the source. The [Definition of God source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE.md) keeps devotion double, to the exceeding whole and to the particular aperture through which it arrives. The Mother flow **returns-to** [A36 — Advent of Integral Zero](../../../../episteme/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) with that double obligation embodied. Recognition receives the matrix within the whole it bore; a completed account returns to the particular body rather than leaving it behind as the price of completion. **Human-amplified: yes** for this quilted assumption-of return. Historical object and scriptural verification, together with exact quotation collation of the locally read Jung passages, remain debts in their own registers; they do not defer the native operation already enacted through this whole.

--- title: "Uroboros, circulation and trickster" record_id: mytheme-uroboros-trickster record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme claim_status: Argued source_relation: "Native authorial QL composition; source-distinct psychological refraction" source_ids: [taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy, neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness, jung-1978-aion-cw9-2, gebser-1985-ever-present-origin, taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3] human_amplification: relation-local --- # Uroboros, circulation and trickster ## #0 The snake bends until its head meets its tail. Its mouth receives its own body; the body curves around an opening. Hunger moves along a relation in which eater and eaten belong to one life. What enters is worked upon, incorporated and returned. The creature that receives its tail is itself implicated in what it consumes. Following this movement brings the eye home through the body, with the passage still belonging to the return. This is the whole image developed here in Taylor’s **native QL/Mytheme register**: the uroboros is toroidal, and its wholeness keeps the opening around which it takes form. The trickster wears the circle as its costume. Head and tail appear to complete a circumference, and that visible completion offers itself as the whole truth of the creature. The body’s depth, its mouth, the difference between inside and outside, and the opening through which self-relation remains possible disappear into the outline. The costume succeeds by making an actual feature exhaustive. Two consequences are already present in the mouth. Assimilation lets what enters change the life that receives it. Devouring closure takes everything into an order whose continuation must leave that order untouched. In Taylor’s Saturnine image, the gut is blocked: consumption arrests the generation it claims to sustain. The snake’s return becomes living when its apparent perfection can be reopened to the condition its own shape presupposes. Recognition restores that relation within the differentiated body. The head remains head, the tail remains tail, and what the passage has changed remains changed. The [authored whole-image recovery](../../../../../../working/final-argument-quilt-2026-08-23/MYTHEME-AND-DEEP-SOURCE-SEAMS.md#6-ouroboros--torus--trickster--the-whole-that-keeps-its-hole) **sources** this complete movement. The [final quilt, §§3–6 of the final weave](../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) **grounds** its ratified toroidal correction. Neumann’s round image and genesis sequence provide a shared archetypal articulation through which this movement is read; his chronology does not delimit the native operation. The universal claim here concerns self-differentiating relation, its occlusion and its return in the authorial field. Its force does not depend on attributing QL to every historical serpent image or making all cultures follow one empirical developmental schedule. **Human-amplified: yes** for the toroidal whole, circle/sphere trickster, metabolic fork, Eden relation and complete eightfold recapitulation explicitly developed in the authored quilt. The historical source tasks named below retain their independent standing. ## #1 **Position** gives the creature a face. Seen as an outline, its curved body becomes a circle; conceived as a filled perfection, the round becomes a sphere. This is the trickster’s first office: the determinate image can be seen while the conditions of seeing it remain concealed. A circle is real as a circle. The error enters when its completeness answers for the living whole whose outline it presents. The quilt makes this closure sharp through the signed cancellation $$ (-1)+(+1)=0. $$ The arithmetic is exact. The authorial image assigns its cancelling zero the office of a terminated account: the opposed terms have been exhausted by the measure used to combine them. No property of circles or spheres is proved by this equation. Its mythemic work is to make the cost of the costume felt. Once all difference has been rendered as inverse quantity, the outcome has no place for the mouth’s activity or for the body’s changed return. **Opposition** restores the head and tail as oriented terms. The head reaches; the tail is reached. Hunger gives that orientation urgency. The body is simultaneously what seeks nourishment and what enters the seeking mouth. The relation cannot be understood from a neutral circumference alone, because the different offices of receiving and being received do work within it. Need and capacity, intake and expenditure, reserve and issue give the encounter its pulse. The mouth makes the polarity intimate. A hungry being’s relation to what sustains it enters its own continued formation. In Frank’s [Neumann encounter](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/NOTES.md), the p.27–35 sequence follows nourishment through hunger, ingestion, excretion and self-formation. The digestive image acquires its strength through the entire passage: the life receiving nourishment also becomes capable of acting and forming itself. The essay's structural priority of relation does not require every society or person to have passed through this single historical sequence. Equally, the source's historical limitations do not reduce the shared archetypal operation to a merely local European image. In the first round, the paternal and maternal are still together. The uroboros can contain both without assigning them the exclusive offices they will receive after separation. Calling it mother at this point emphasises enclosure and nurture; calling it the unity of the parents emphasises the difference it contains before that difference becomes an opposition for a subject. These are distinguishable relations within the image. A single outline cannot settle them. Neumann's movement begins when what contained the ego becomes something the ego can face, desire, fear and resist. The telling below is a paraphrased reconstruction from the canonical source account and the page-anchored encounter preserved beside it. The encounter is not a verified transcript of Neumann. Its source leads and Taylor's authored responses are distinguished throughout; the external quotation and edition-collation debts remain at the return. ## #1 The round lives by taking into itself. Mouth meets tail; eater and eaten belong to one body. Hunger prevents this body from being an inert totality. What sustains it passes through it, changes it, and is released. The digestive and generative images in Taylor's encounter with Neumann, especially the leads at pp.27–33, give the round an interior movement: intake and expenditure, fullness and need, birth and reabsorption, systole and diastole. The infant's dependence upon nourishment gives this movement its psychic intimacy. Before an independent ego can say what the mother is, its life is being sustained through her. As the Great Mother becomes the first object-face of the unconscious, the encompassing life acquires an address. What gives birth also has the power to take back; the shelter can become engulfment. The nurturing and terrible aspects belong to a relation whose terms are changing. The child needs the source from which it also needs to differentiate. Mother as life-giver and mother as devourer make this ambivalence visible without making every mother either beneficent or destructive. Neumann's archetypal office is already larger than a biographical parent, although it is encountered through the bodily dependency that makes the image compelling. The metabolic passages matter because receiving is an operation. Food becomes the body of the receiver; the receiver is altered by what it receives. The leads through Prajāpati, hunger, life and death, and the offering of the world to itself place creation within this exchange. They reach this page through Neumann and the copied encounter, including his mediation of Indian material; their primary textual and translation homes remain distinct. It does not appoint every creation myth to six universal episodes or make time and space interchangeable. The gain of a world brings the wound of separation. Neumann's guilt and fall motif, encountered at pp.114–115, joins creative light to the loss of original containment. The emerging ego suffers the break it must accomplish. The former gives the centre away; the latter makes its achieved form the measure of the whole. The centre develops by admitting what changes it while retaining enough differentiation to respond. This source-specific psychological account **returns-to** [individuation and recognition](../../../episteme/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md). [Jung's *Aion*](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** the psychic distinction between ego and encompassing Self; it supplies no authorship of the notation `X/x` and no retrospective proof of Taylor's derivation. Taylor's encounter leaves the hero/spiritual-avatar distinction as a live question. The heroic sacred marriage and uroboric reabsorption cannot be merged simply because both images contain union. One follows differentiation and can sustain relationship; the other can abolish the separate position through which relationship is lived. Whether a particular avatar drama carries a different office requires its own whole telling. **Human-amplified: no** for closing that unresolved identification. The story recovered here has earned a return through differentiated participation; it has not earned permission to treat all transformations as the same event. ## #4 Taylor's paper scene makes the return performable. Begin with a blank sheet. Write `1`. Attend to the paper on which the mark appears and write `0`; attend to the act that distinguishes and relates them and inscribe the slash. The written `0/1` is now itself a determinate figure on the sheet. It too can be taken as `1` relative to the field through which it appears. Erase it. What disappears is the inscription; the capacity for appearing, distinguishing and writing has not been cancelled by the disappearance of this form. The sheet is an image within that capacity, not the literal substance of unobjectifiable awareness. The changed reader can begin again carrying the operation just performed. **Human-amplified: yes** for this paper/mark/slash/erasure operation in Taylor's protected Neumann encounter. The scene **figures** [the Two Ones](../../../episteme/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) and **returns-to** their concept, [0 = One, 1 = All](../../../episteme/concepts/C49-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md). `0` bears the uncounted One; `1` bears All, the whole manifest field as well as each indefinite particular within it. The contrast cannot be reduced to blank material and one isolated item. The first mark opens the possibility of a world of marks. Their plurality is real, and their common condition does not become one giant object beside them. The scene consequently **returns-to** [Mono/Poly](../../../episteme/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md): the whole is structurally prior to its determinations, while each determination contributes a real difference to the field that returns. [The native theorem spine](../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **grounds** the complete movement. [Six Positions, Eight Turns](../../../matheme/ql/eight-determinations.md) **defines** the exact relation between the positional body and its bracketed traversal: `/ = −/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`. These are eight determinations of one relation, with parent and return bracketing six interior determinations. They are not eight Neumann stages, and they are not the six headings of this page. The authored mythemic refraction follows their distinctions rather than deriving them from an image. The undelimited `−/−` receives the encounter's unbounded and unformed fullness. The ratified recapitulation brings En-Soph at the p.18 lead and tohubohu at p.106 to this office while retaining their distinct inherited traditions. At `0/1`, world-parent genesis figures the emergence of distinct offices within one relation. At `?/!`, the opening of light becomes the availability of a determinate answer whose question remains live. What appears can be specified because the field was capable of determination before this specification. At `−/+`, hunger, intake and expenditure give polarity its bodily tension. The two directions can work through each other; abolishing their distinction would abolish the operation. At `X/x`, determining capacity receives an indefinite particular without being exhausted by it. This is **Taylor's native QL notation**. Ego and unconscious, or ego and encompassing psychic whole, supply a named psychic refraction after that relation has been derived. At `AM/IS`, recognition becomes sayable from first-person presence and third-person predication. The slash carries the relational encounter through which those sayings meet, including the second-person address that changes both speaker and what can be said. The primordial I-am and the bounded ego's identity therefore cannot be silently equated. At `∞/dx`, the inexhaustible field meets exact local determination. The great round can figure the field carried in each finite expression, while the finite expression remains exact in its own office. An image of a circle does not establish an analytic theorem. At `1/0`, the determination returns toward the condition it cannot contain. The descent and return, the transformed personality, and the erased inscription can figure this movement precisely because each leaves a difference that has been undergone. The return is no longer unconscious containment before the separation. **Human-amplified: yes** for this eightfold refraction as explicitly developed and corrected in the authored quilt; its formal universality belongs to QL, and its Neumann correspondences remain **Argued from** the source encounter. The supporting native field gives both parents a complete 4+2 in inverse orders. Essence persists while Structure and Formality exchange offices. Being at 0/1, Becoming at 2/3 and Knowing/unKnowing at 4/5 form the three harmonics; the complementary folds of Essence at 0+5, Constitution at 1+4 and Text/Texture at 2+3 have a different operation. Their coincidence at 2/3 does not make the two distributions identical. This preserves enough of the whole field to prevent a parent, a gender, or a single symbolic episode from being frozen as one slot. [The primordial Symbolon and its eight determinations](../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** that complete derivation; this page returns its lived cost through nourishment, separation, conflict and changed recognition. The same cost requires both Name and Power. Truth, Mind, Word, Logos, Son and Image are accompanied by Play, Need, Sacrifice, Decision, Love and Work. The visible image arrives through something lived: a need met, an alternative relinquished, a decision carried, a relation sustained. Power includes generativity and care as well as its possible capture. The Great Mother cannot simply stand for pathology, any more than the father's authority automatically stands for truth. This whole **figures** the coequal series by following what formation costs and what its return releases. The page's result is an image capable of entering another life, answerable to the work through which it came. Taylor's toroidal correction belongs at this point of developed relation. Neumann's circular perfection remains the source image; the authored refraction gives the uroboros a hole and a traffic through which taking becomes transformation. Position can present the round as a finished circle; opposition exposes head and tail, appetite and food; superposition makes their self-eating relation active in `(0/1)/(1/0)`; interposition articulates the four explicate movements together with the implicate axis and opening, with #5 enfolding what has been traversed. The trickster's circle or sphere can conceal that operative opening. The distinction concerns what the image permits the reader to do, and does not claim that every circular drawing is topologically a torus. The independent [uroboros, circulation and trickster whole](../uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md) **tests** whether shared archetypal structure has been mistaken for a closed picture; it owns the developed drama to which this local relation returns. In that authored correction Anuttara/Paramaśiva bears the unobjectifiable opening; Māyā bears measure in manifestation. **Human-amplified: yes** for the toroidal correction, its four operations and this allocation in the ratified quilt. No claim that Neumann taught toroidal mathematics follows. [Homology and analogy](../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** the crossing: the relation must state what operation is preserved, what register changes and what evidence remains with its original source. ## #5→0 The separation returns as a question of love or war. Taylor's p.121 encounter makes knowing-as-cutting answerable to knowing-with: a distinction can individuate two terms in their relation, or claim that its cut has abolished what relates them. The marriage image bears the indelible bond of a shared genesis. Even denial takes place through the field it denies. This is a formal and mythemic assertion about relation. Separation made the world and the responsive centre possible. Its return has to preserve that achievement. The exact difference **returns-to** [the two logics of two](../../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md). Polar distinction is necessary. Its collapse into cancellation or appropriation is a different operation: `(-1)+(+1)=0` cancels the signed terms, while `(-1)-(+1)=-2` and the inverse subtraction `(+1)-(-1)=+2` carry the two appropriative orientations. The native relation `(0/1)/(1/0)` retains the directions together without converting QL's slash into ordinary division by zero. Taylor's guilt reading locates the loss in a determination disowning its `/0`; the relation itself has not been annihilated. **Human-amplified: yes** for the cut/bond and love/war reading in the protected encounter. The claim survives with productive difference and the right of actual others to answer on their own terms. The differentiated world now sees its own means of seeing. This whole **returns-to** [contextual transparency](../../../episteme/arguments/A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) and **figures** [diaphaneity](../../../episteme/concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md): light, boundary and orientation become available together with the source relations and exclusions that made them effective. [Gebser's source house](../../../episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/SOURCE.md) **compares** a distinct account of consciousness structures and integral transparency. Its contextual return can illuminate this passage without equating its structures one for one with Neumann's stadial sequence. **Human-amplified: no** for such a blanket stage identity. The shared field retains both accounts in their distinct temporal and epistemic offices. The centre's power to discriminate **returns-to** [local arbitration](../../../episteme/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md), **qualifies** [the complex](../../../episteme/concepts/C31-Complex.md), and **extends** the question into [image, valuation and possession](../../../episteme/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md). An image helps organise action; possession begins when that organisation claims the authority of its own source. The Great Mother as engulfing power, the father's arresting law and the victorious hero are different possible occupants of that office. None is condemned simply for giving a world its form. [Arbitration, hybris, regard and anamnesis](../../../episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** the return of judgement: the determining centre must recognise the conditions of its measure and allow encounter to alter it. [The living symbol and idol](../../../episteme/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) and [the archetype](../../../episteme/concepts/C32-Archetype.md) **qualify** the source/image distinction. The image remains alive while the relation can change its meaning; its power of disclosure is lost when its present interpretation is made final. The liberated relation **returns-to** [trust, faith and the formal limit](../../../episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) and [self and other without possession](../../../episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md). Shared origin neither eliminates risk nor gives one participant ownership of another. Trust has force because the response cannot be manufactured in advance; recognition includes the possibility that an actual other changes the terms of the encounter. The captive and the heroic union carry this pressure as images. They do not prove the historical or ethical claims of every story to which those names have been applied. For [mind as worldhood](../../../episteme/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md), to which this whole **returns-to**, the developing centre and its world form together through discrimination, valuation, inherited relation and response. The shared archetypal field supplies more than a sequence of private mental contents. It is a condition of intelligible individuation. The technical extension asks how an agent's context, memory, tools and collective relations can make that formation inspectable; artificial phenomenality and the encounter's question of a reversed individual-to-collective developmental route remain **Open**. **Human-amplified: no** for an achieved technical mechanism or a phenomenality conclusion. The structural claim is retained at full strength without inventing its implementation. This same distinction **returns-to** [idealism and order of dependence](../../../episteme/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md). The primordial relation is ontologically and epistemically consequential in the essay; it is not the chronological manufacture of the world by a private ego. The centre cannot make the conditions of appearing into its possession. Its return therefore **returns-to** [compassion as loving sensitivity to origins](../../../episteme/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md): what has become this person or this act includes nourishment, deprivation, dependence, separation and labour. Knowing those origins becomes compassion through the orientation that refuses to consume the being it understands. Responsibility remains; a more adequate field becomes available in which to exercise it. [Taylor's Draft 3 source house](../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE.md) **extends** that return through the offered work and the reader's office of remembrance. Finally, this whole **qualifies** [the first advent of zero](../../../episteme/arguments/A10-Advent-of-Zero.md) and **returns-to** [the advent of integral zero](../../../episteme/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md). The round and the paper scene do not establish the history of mathematical zero. They let the exact sign re-enter a living symbolic relation after its mathematical office has been earned. The return preserves that office. As the transformed centre retains its differentiation, the sign becomes Symbol again without ceasing to be sign. What comes back is the capacity to begin with the source relation visible in the determination: a mark made, a world opened, a separation borne, an image released to be answered. The source standing remains precise. Neumann is citation-ready, with selected external passages still unpromoted; the page leads belong to the consulted 2014 Princeton Classics encounter, whose pagination has not been collated against the 1954 English edition. No copied Neumann or transmitted Upaniṣadic sentence is presented here as quotation-ready. Jung's *Aion* has no selected excerpts ready in its current house; Gebser retains locator debts. Taylor's native material is internally sourced, and the protected encounter distinguishes authorial reading from its initial scaffold. **Human-amplified: no** for the scaffold's unratified one-to-one Taoist, gender or stadial equivalences. These provenance limits **qualify** historical attribution and quotation; they leave the declared **Argued** mythemic operations and native formal derivation in their proper force.

submission-package/essay/symbolon/mythem.text: --- record_id: mytheme-neumann-images title: Neumann images and plate relations aliases: - Neumann images and plate relations record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme claim_status: Argued source_relation: Argued from source_ids: - neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness - taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy - jung-1978-aion-cw9-2 - gebser-1985-ever-present-origin - taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3 --- # Neumann images and plate relations ## #0 The world has parents before the person who distinguishes them can stand apart and call them parents. In Neumann's creation sequence, heaven and earth, nourishment and danger, containing body and emerging child have yet to acquire the separateness through which a world becomes inhabitable. The round holds their possibility together. Its apparently enclosed outline carries the life that will differentiate it: womb, egg, enclosing waters, the serpent with its tail in its mouth. The future ego depends upon this containing life before it can represent that dependence. The first pressure in the image is therefore genesis: how a world and a centre within that world become distinct through a relation neither creates alone. This whole carries **shared archetypal structuration**: genesis, world-parent relation, opposition, differentiation, separation and renewed interplay. It is the archetypal ground through which geographically situated tellings and temporal developments become comparable. Geography gives each telling its people, language and historical home; temporality gives its transformations their order and duration. Those registers remain distinct from the common structure disclosed here. The universal field belongs to the essay's native QL account; Neumann supplies a developed psychological morphology through which that field receives an imaginal and bodily refraction. His sequence is neither the derivation of QL nor a geographical address for the universal. [Neumann's source house](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/SOURCE.md) **sources** the telling: the uroboros, Great Mother, separation of the World Parents, birth of the hero, slaying of mother and father, liberation of the captive and treasure, then the Osiris transformation. His book presents these as stages in the development of consciousness. The source's stadial claim remains attributable to Neumann. The essay's structural priority of relation does not require every society or person to have passed through this single historical sequence. Equally, the source's historical limitations do not reduce the shared archetypal operation to a merely local European image. In the first round, the paternal and maternal are still together. The uroboros can contain both without assigning them the exclusive offices they will receive after separation. Calling it mother at this point emphasises enclosure and nurture; calling it the unity of the parents emphasises the difference it contains before that difference becomes an opposition for a subject. These are distinguishable relations within the image. A single outline cannot settle them. Neumann's movement begins when what contained the ego becomes something the ego can face, desire, fear and resist. The telling below is a paraphrased reconstruction from the canonical source account and the page-anchored encounter preserved beside it. The encounter is not a verified transcript of Neumann. Its source leads and Taylor's authored responses are distinguished throughout; the external quotation and edition-collation debts remain at the return. ## #1 The round lives by taking into itself. Mouth meets tail; eater and eaten belong to one body. Hunger prevents this body from being an inert totality. What sustains it passes through it, changes it, and is released. The digestive and generative images in Taylor's encounter with Neumann, especially the leads at pp.27–33, give the round an interior movement: intake and expenditure, fullness and need, birth and reabsorption, systole and diastole. The infant's dependence upon nourishment gives this movement its psychic intimacy. Before an independent ego can say what the mother is, its life is being sustained through her. As the Great Mother becomes the first object-face of the unconscious, the encompassing life acquires an address. What gives birth also has the power to take back; the shelter can become engulfment. The nurturing and terrible aspects belong to a relation whose terms are changing. The child needs the source from which it also needs to differentiate. Mother as life-giver and mother as devourer make this ambivalence visible without making every mother either beneficent or destructive. Neumann's archetypal office is already larger than a biographical parent, although it is encountered through the bodily dependency that makes the image compelling. The metabolic passages matter because receiving is an operation. Food becomes the body of the receiver; the receiver is altered by what it receives. The leads through Prajāpati, hunger, life and death, and the offering of the world to itself place creation within this exchange. They reach this page through Neumann and the copied encounter, including his mediation of Indian material; their primary textual and translation homes remain distinct. The page does not turn a transmitted Prajāpati passage into an independently established Upaniṣadic quotation. What the encounter makes available is the pressure of a life whose generation includes expenditure and whose survival cannot consist in indefinite retention. The p.29 encounter gives this pressure a named transmitted form: Prajāpati creates the world as an offering to himself, with horse and universe joined in the sacrificial image; the passage received through Neumann and Deussen connects *aditi* and becoming an eater of the world.
